en_us: Five furrows, one per tier: inferium in the first, diamonds in the last.
es_es: Cinco surcos, uno por nivel: inferium en el primero, diamantes en el último.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

en_us.title: First essence
en_us.subtitle: Every mob pays a tithe, sometimes.
text: [lead] Eight [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Inferium Essence] buy your first seeds.
[li] Most mobs drop one in [b|5] kills.
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_ore|Inferium Ore], from Y [b|-32] to [b|64], breaks into [b|2] to [b|4], more with Fortune.

es_es.title: La primera esencia
es_es.subtitle: Todo mob paga diezmo, a veces.
text: [lead] Ocho [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Esencias de inferium] pagan tus primeras semillas.
[li] La mayoría de los mobs suelta una cada [b|5] muertes.
[li] La [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_ore|Mena de inferium], de Y [b|-32] a [b|64], se rompe en [b|2] a [b|4], más con Fortuna.

en_us.title: The other half
text: [lead] Prosperity turns plain things magical.
[li] Seed bases
[li] Crystals
[li] Ingots
[li] Gems
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ore|Prosperity Ore] sits deeper, from Y [b|-60] to [b|24].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard] Each ore breaks into [b|1] to [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard|Prosperity Shards].

es_es.title: La otra mitad
text: [lead] La prosperidad vuelve mágico lo común.
[li] Bases de semillas
[li] Cristales
[li] Lingotes
[li] Gemas
[li] La [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ore|Mena de prosperidad] está más abajo, de Y [b|-60] a [b|24].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard] Cada mena se rompe en [b|1] a [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard|Fragmentos de prosperidad].

en_us.title: Eight pedestals and a wand
en_us.subtitle: Seed crafting, now in 3D.
text: [lead] Every seed is crafted here: eight items around, one in the middle.
[li] Gold, red wool and stone make the [item:mysticalagriculture:infusion_altar|Infusion Altar] and its [item:mysticalagriculture:infusion_pedestal|Infusion Pedestals].
[li] Placed, the altar shows where the pedestals go.
[li:mysticalagriculture:wand] Load them, set the centre item, tap the altar with a [item:mysticalagriculture:wand|Wand].
{page}
[li] Pedestals stand [b|3] blocks out on each side and [b|2] out on each diagonal.
[li] The wand is an inferium essence, a stick and a stone.

es_es.title: Ocho pedestales y una varita
es_es.subtitle: Fabricar semillas, ahora en 3D.
text: [lead] Acá se fabrica cada semilla: ocho ítems alrededor y uno en el medio.
[li] Oro, lana roja y piedra hacen el [item:mysticalagriculture:infusion_altar|Altar de infusión] y sus [item:mysticalagriculture:infusion_pedestal|Pedestales de infusión].
[li] Al colocarlo, el altar muestra dónde va cada pedestal.
[li:mysticalagriculture:wand] Cargalos, poné la pieza central y tocá el altar con una [item:mysticalagriculture:wand|Varita].
{page}
[li] Los pedestales van a [b|3] bloques de cada lado y a [b|2] en cada diagonal.
[li] La varita es una esencia de inferium, un palo y una piedra.

en_us.title: The heart of every seed
text: [lead] Every resource seed grows from a [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base|Prosperity Seed Base].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard] Recipe: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard|Prosperity Shards] around a wheat seed.
[li] It goes on the altar; the pedestals take [b|4] of the material and [b|4] essences of the seed's tier.

es_es.title: El corazón de cada semilla
text: [lead] Cada semilla de recurso nace de una [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base|Base de semillas de prosperidad].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard] Receta: [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard|Fragmentos de prosperidad] alrededor de una semilla de trigo.
[li] Va en el altar; los pedestales llevan [b|4] del material y [b|4] esencias del nivel de la semilla.

en_us.title: Every seed pays the next
text: [tip] Every seed pays for the heart of the next: a [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base|Prosperity Seed Base].
[li] From tier [hl|2] up, a random seed from the tier below comes along.
[li] Plant a whole bed and harvest it: pick a bonus.

es_es.title: Cada semilla paga la siguiente
text: [tip] Cada semilla paga el corazón de la siguiente: una [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base|Base de semillas de prosperidad].
[li] Desde el nivel [hl|2] viene con una semilla al azar del nivel de abajo.
[li] Sembrá un cantero entero y cosechalo: elegí un premio.

en_us.title: What this pack changes
text: [lead] No seed here is gated: every recipe is the mod's own.
[li] The Altar of Growth speeds mystical crops up but never multiplies their essence.
[li] Mekanism More Machine's planting recipes for these seeds are removed.

es_es.title: Qué cambia este pack
text: [lead] Ninguna semilla tiene puerta: cada receta es la del mod.
[li] El Altar de Crecimiento acelera los cultivos místicos pero nunca multiplica su esencia.
[li] Se quitaron las recetas de plantado de Mekanism More Machine para estas semillas.

en_us.title: The manual in the box
text: [tip] A [item:minecraft:book|Book] and one [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Inferium Essence] make the mod's own guide.
[li] Every block, machine and augment, each with its recipe.

es_es.title: El manual en la caja
text: [tip] Un [item:minecraft:book|Libro] y una [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence|Esencia de inferium] hacen la guía del mod.
[li] Cada bloque, máquina y aumento, con su receta.

en_us.title: A wand that never gets lost
text: [tip] A redstone pulse starts the altar just like the wand.
[li] The craft finishes [b|5] seconds later.
[li] A button on a block beside it saves hunting for the wand.

es_es.title: Una varita que no se pierde
text: [tip] Un pulso de redstone arranca el altar igual que la varita.
[li] La fabricación termina [b|5] segundos después.
[li] Un botón en un bloque al lado te ahorra buscar la varita.

en_us.title: Bees with essence
text: [tip] [quest:bees_mod_ma|Productive Bees] keeps essence bees too.
[li] An Inferium Bee's combs spin into [b|2] to [b|4] inferium in a centrifuge.
[li] Every tier above has a bee of its own.

es_es.title: Abejas con esencia
text: [tip] [quest:bees_mod_ma|Productive Bees] también tiene abejas de esencia.
[li] Los panales de una abeja de inferium dan de [b|2] a [b|4] inferium en la centrífuga.
[li] Cada nivel de arriba tiene su propia abeja.

en_us.title: Essence, gift-wrapped
en_us.subtitle: Some people open presents very carefully.
text: [lead] Silk Touch keeps [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_ore|Inferium Ore] whole.
[li] A furnace turns it into [b|1] essence.
[li] A pickaxe would have given [b|2] to [b|4].

es_es.title: Esencia envuelta para regalo
es_es.subtitle: Hay gente que abre los regalos con mucho cuidado.
text: [lead] Toque de seda conserva la [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_ore|Mena de inferium] entera.
[li] El horno la vuelve [b|1] esencia.
[li] El pico te hubiera dado de [b|2] a [b|4].

en_us.title: Ingots and gems of luck
text: [lead] Prosperity metal becomes each tier's ingot and gemstone.
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot] Four shards around an iron ingot: a [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot|Prosperity Ingot].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_gemstone] Around a diamond: a [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_gemstone|Prosperity Gemstone].
[li] Add two essences of a tier: that tier's ingot or gemstone.

es_es.title: Lingotes y gemas de la suerte
text: [lead] El metal de prosperidad se vuelve el lingote y la gema de cada nivel.
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot] Cuatro fragmentos alrededor de un lingote de hierro: un [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ingot|Lingote de prosperidad].
[li:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_gemstone] Alrededor de un diamante: una [item:mysticalagriculture:prosperity_gemstone|Gema de prosperidad].
[li] Con dos esencias de un nivel: el lingote o la gema de ese nivel.

en_us.title: Growth from below
text: [lead] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_growth_accelerator|Inferium Growth Accelerators] push the plant above them.
[li] Stacked under the farmland, each gives a growth tick every [b|10] seconds.
[li] An inferium one reaches [b|9] blocks up.
[li] Recipe: [b|4] inferium, [b|4] stone and an inferium gemstone, for [b|3].
{page}
[li] Each tier reaches [b|9] blocks further, up to [b|54] for awakened supremium.
[li] Tiers mix freely while the plant is in range.

es_es.title: Crecer desde abajo
text: [lead] Los [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_growth_accelerator|Aceleradores de crecimiento de inferium] empujan a la planta de arriba.
[li] Apilados bajo la tierra, cada uno da un tick de crecimiento cada [b|10] segundos.
[li] El de inferium llega a [b|9] bloques de altura.
[li] Receta: [b|4] inferium, [b|4] piedras y una gema de inferium, para [b|3].
{page}
[li] Cada nivel llega [b|9] bloques más lejos, hasta [b|54] el de supremium despertado.
[li] Los niveles se mezclan mientras la planta esté al alcance.

en_us.title: Rain on demand
text: [lead] A [item:mysticalagriculture:watering_can|Watering Can] waters a [b|3×3] patch.
[li] Recipe: bone meal, a bowl and iron.
[li] Fill it at water and hold use over the crops.
[li] About one pass in four gives each plant a growth tick.

es_es.title: Lluvia a pedido
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:watering_can|Regadera] riega un cuadro de [b|3×3].
[li] Receta: polvo de hueso, un cuenco y hierro.
[li] Llenala en agua y mantené el uso sobre los cultivos.
[li] Más o menos una pasada de cada cuatro da un tick de crecimiento.

en_us.title: Cans that water themselves
text: [lead] An [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_watering_can|Inferium Watering Can] waters on its own.
[li:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer] Recipe: the can, [b|4] inferium ingots and [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer|Mystical Fertilizer].
[li] Hold [key:key.sneak] and press [key:key.use] at the sky to switch it on.
{page}
[li] Each tier adds [b|2] blocks of reach and [b|5] points of chance.
[li] Up to [b|13×13] at [b|50%] for awakened supremium.

es_es.title: Regaderas que riegan solas
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_watering_can|Regadera de inferium] riega sola.
[li:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer] Receta: la regadera, [b|4] lingotes de inferium y [b|4] [item:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer|Fertilizantes místicos].
[li] Mantené [key:key.sneak] y apretá [key:key.use] mirando al cielo para encenderla.
{page}
[li] Cada nivel suma [b|2] bloques de alcance y [b|5] puntos de chance.
[li] Hasta [b|13×13] al [b|50%] con la de supremium despertado.

en_us.title: Reap, don't uproot
text: [lead] A [item:mysticalagriculture:diamond_scythe|Diamond Scythe] harvests every ripe crop in reach and leaves the plants.
[li:mysticalagriculture:diamond_sickle] The [item:mysticalagriculture:diamond_sickle|Diamond Sickle] clears plants in an area.
[li] Both are diamonds and sticks.
{page}
[li] Essence tiers widen both; the scythe also hits everything around its target.

es_es.title: Cosechar sin arrancar
text: [lead] La [item:mysticalagriculture:diamond_scythe|Guadaña de diamante] cosecha todo lo maduro a su alcance sin arrancar las plantas.
[li:mysticalagriculture:diamond_sickle] La [item:mysticalagriculture:diamond_sickle|Hoz de diamante] despeja plantas en área.
[li] Las dos son diamantes y palos.
{page}
[li] Los niveles de esencia las agrandan; la guadaña además le pega a todo lo que rodea al objetivo.

en_us.title: Instant harvest
en_us.subtitle: Bone meal with a doctorate.
text: [lead] One [item:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer|Mystical Fertilizer] grows any crop to full at once.
[li] Resource crops included, where bone meal fails.
[li] Recipe: bone meal, inferium and a diamond, for [b|4].

es_es.title: Cosecha al instante
es_es.subtitle: Polvo de hueso con doctorado.
text: [lead] Un [item:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer|Fertilizante místico] hace crecer del todo cualquier cultivo.
[li] También los de recursos, donde el polvo de hueso falla.
[li] Receta: polvo de hueso, inferium y un diamante, para [b|4].

en_us.title: Leftover magic
text: [lead] Resource crops drop [item:mysticalagriculture:fertilized_essence|Fertilized Essence] [b|10%] of the time; inferium never does.
[li] It is bone meal that mystical crops accept.
[li] Four of it in the fertilizer recipe make [b|8] instead of [b|4].

es_es.title: Magia que sobra
text: [lead] Los cultivos de recursos sueltan [item:mysticalagriculture:fertilized_essence|Esencia fertilizada] el [b|10%] de las veces; el inferium, nunca.
[li] Es un polvo de hueso que los cultivos místicos sí aceptan.
[li] Cuatro en la receta del fertilizante dan [b|8] en vez de [b|4].

en_us.title: Seeds that grow essence
en_us.subtitle: Magic, in rows.
text: [lead] [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_seeds|Inferium Seeds] grow the essence everything else costs.
[li] Recipe: [b|8] inferium around a wheat seed.
[li] Each harvest gives [b|1] essence and the seed back.
[li:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer] Bone meal does nothing to them; [item:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer|Mystical Fertilizer] does.

es_es.title: Semillas que dan esencia
es_es.subtitle: Magia, en surcos.
text: [lead] Las [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_seeds|Semillas de inferium] dan la esencia que todo lo demás cuesta.
[li] Receta: [b|8] inferium alrededor de una semilla de trigo.
[li] Cada cosecha da [b|1] esencia y te devuelve la semilla.
[li:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer] El polvo de hueso no les hace nada; el [item:mysticalagriculture:mystical_fertilizer|Fertilizante místico], sí.

en_us.title: Seasoned soil
text: [lead] Right-click farmland with an essence and it turns into that tier's farmland.
[li] First up: [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_farmland|Inferium Farmland].
[li] A hoe, the essence and dirt in the grid work too.
[li] Only essence farmland gives crops a shot at a second seed.

es_es.title: Tierra curada
text: [lead] Clic derecho a la tierra de cultivo con una esencia y se vuelve la tierra de ese nivel.
[li] La primera: [item:mysticalagriculture:inferium_farmland|Tierra de cultivo de inferium].
[li] Una azada, la esencia y tierra en la mesa también sirven.
[li] Sólo en tierra de esencia un cultivo puede dar una segunda semilla.

en_us.title: Twice lucky
text: [tip] On any essence farmland a resource crop has [b|10%] odds of a second seed.
[li] Rolled apart, [b|10%] of a second essence.
[li] On the farmland of its own tier, both rise to [b|20%].

es_es.title: Doble suerte
text: [tip] En cualquier tierra de esencia un cultivo de recursos tiene [b|10%] de dar otra semilla.
[li] Por separado, [b|10%] de dar otra esencia.
[li] En la tierra de su propio nivel, las dos suben a [b|20%].

en_us.title: Better dirt, bigger harvest
text: [tip] Inferium's essence grows with the soil.
[li] [b|1] on plain or inferium farmland, [b|2] on tertium, [b|3] on supremium.
[li] Prudentium and imperium add a coin flip for one more.

es_es.title: Mejor tierra, más cosecha
text: [tip] La esencia del inferium sube con la tierra.
[li] [b|1] en tierra común o de inferium, [b|2] en tertium, [b|3] en supremium.
[li] El prudentium y el imperium suman una más a cara o cruz.

en_us.title: A crystal that climbs
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:infusion_crystal|Infusion Crystal] turns [b|4] essences of a tier into [b|1] of the next.
[li] Recipe: a diamond, [b|4] prosperity shards and [b|4] inferium.
[li] It lasts [b|1000] crafts.
[li] Going down is free: one essence breaks into four of the tier below.

es_es.title: Un cristal para subir
text: [lead] El [item:mysticalagriculture:infusion_crystal|Cristal de infusión] vuelve [b|4] esencias de un nivel [b|1] del siguiente.
[li] Receta: un diamante, [b|4] fragmentos de prosperidad y [b|4] inferium.
[li] Aguanta [b|1000] fabricaciones.
[li] Bajar es gratis: una esencia vuelve a ser cuatro del nivel de abajo.

en_us.title: Tier 2: prudentium
en_us.subtitle: Every tier costs four of the last.
text: [lead] Four inferium around the crystal make one [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence].
[li] Right-click farmland with it: [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_farmland|Prudentium Farmland].
[li] Tier-[hl|2] seeds take [b|4] prudentium on the pedestals.

es_es.title: Nivel 2: prudentium
es_es.subtitle: Cada nivel cuesta cuatro del anterior.
text: [lead] Cuatro inferium alrededor del cristal dan una [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencia de prudentium].
[li] Clic derecho con ella en tierra de cultivo: [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_farmland|Tierra de cultivo de prudentium].
[li] Las semillas de nivel [hl|2] piden [b|4] prudentium en los pedestales.

en_us.title: Tier 3: tertium
en_us.subtitle: Where iron starts to grow.
text: [lead] Four prudentium make one [item:mysticalagriculture:tertium_essence|Tertium Essence]: [b|16] inferium deep.
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:tertium_farmland|Tertium Farmland] feeds tier-[hl|3] crops.
[li] Inferium planted on it yields [b|2] essences a harvest.

es_es.title: Nivel 3: tertium
es_es.subtitle: Donde empieza a crecer el hierro.
text: [lead] Cuatro prudentium dan una [item:mysticalagriculture:tertium_essence|Esencia de tertium]: ya son [b|16] inferium.
[li] La [item:mysticalagriculture:tertium_farmland|Tierra de cultivo de tertium] alimenta a los cultivos de nivel [hl|3].
[li] El inferium plantado ahí da [b|2] esencias por cosecha.

en_us.title: Tier 4: imperium
en_us.subtitle: Sixty-four inferium in a trench coat.
text: [lead] Four tertium make one [item:mysticalagriculture:imperium_essence|Imperium Essence]: [b|64] inferium all told.
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:imperium_farmland|Imperium Farmland] suits gold, lapis, the End and most mod alloys.

es_es.title: Nivel 4: imperium
es_es.subtitle: Sesenta y cuatro inferium disfrazados de uno.
text: [lead] Cuatro tertium dan una [item:mysticalagriculture:imperium_essence|Esencia de imperium]: [b|64] inferium en total.
[li] La [item:mysticalagriculture:imperium_farmland|Tierra de cultivo de imperium] es la del oro, el lapislázuli, el End y casi todas las aleaciones.

en_us.title: Tier 5: supremium
en_us.subtitle: The top of the ladder. Almost.
text: [lead] Four imperium make one [item:mysticalagriculture:supremium_essence|Supremium Essence]: [b|256] inferium in one orb.
[li] [item:mysticalagriculture:supremium_farmland|Supremium Farmland] is the best soil there is.
[li] Inferium on it yields [b|3] essences a harvest.

es_es.title: Nivel 5: supremium
es_es.subtitle: La cima de la escalera. Casi.
text: [lead] Cuatro imperium dan una [item:mysticalagriculture:supremium_essence|Esencia de supremium]: [b|256] inferium en una esfera.
[li] La [item:mysticalagriculture:supremium_farmland|Tierra de cultivo de supremium] es la mejor que hay.
[li] El inferium ahí da [b|3] esencias por cosecha.

en_us.title: The crystal that never cracks
en_us.subtitle: A thousand uses was never enough.
text: [lead] The [item:mysticalagriculture:master_infusion_crystal|Master Infusion Crystal] has no durability at all.
[li:mysticalagriculture:supremium_gemstone] Recipe: [b|4] supremium, [b|4] prosperity shards and a [item:mysticalagriculture:supremium_gemstone|Supremium Gemstone].
[li] It also fuses four essence blocks into one block of the next tier.

es_es.title: El cristal que no se rompe
es_es.subtitle: Mil usos nunca alcanzaron.
text: [lead] El [item:mysticalagriculture:master_infusion_crystal|Cristal de infusión maestro] no tiene durabilidad.
[li:mysticalagriculture:supremium_gemstone] Receta: [b|4] supremium, [b|4] fragmentos de prosperidad y una [item:mysticalagriculture:supremium_gemstone|Gema de supremium].
[li] Además fusiona cuatro bloques de esencia en uno del nivel siguiente.

en_us.title: Prudentium for the common store
en_us.subtitle: The nursery always wants more.
text: [lead] Sixteen [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Prudentium Essence] for the common store.
[li] A propagation core takes [b|2]; every tier-[hl|2] seed, [b|4].

es_es.title: Prudentium para el depósito común
es_es.subtitle: El vivero siempre pide más.
text: [lead] Dieciséis [item:mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence|Esencias de prudentium] para el depósito común.
[li] Un núcleo de propagación lleva [b|2]; cada semilla de nivel [hl|2], [b|4].

en_us.title: Stones for Create
text: [tip] Eight stone essences around one metal essence make [b|16] of Create's ore stones.
[li] Iron: [item:create:crimsite|Crimsite]. Zinc: [item:create:asurine|Asurine].
[li] Copper: [item:create:veridium|Veridium]. Gold: [item:create:ochrum|Ochrum].

es_es.title: Piedras para Create
text: [tip] Ocho esencias de piedra alrededor de una de metal dan [b|16] piedras de mena de Create.
[li] Hierro: [item:create:crimsite|Carmesita]. Zinc: [item:create:asurine|Azurina].
[li] Cobre: [item:create:veridium|Veridio]. Oro: [item:create:ochrum|Ocre].

en_us.title: Catalysts, homegrown
en_us.subtitle: No Warden was harmed.
text: [lead] Eight sculk essences make [b|3] [item:minecraft:sculk_catalyst|Sculk Catalysts].
[li] Seven make [b|2] sensors or [b|2] shriekers.

es_es.title: Catalizadores de huerta
es_es.subtitle: Ningún Warden salió herido.
text: [lead] Ocho esencias de sculk dan [b|3] [item:minecraft:sculk_catalyst|Catalizadores de sculk].
[li] Siete dan [b|2] sensores o [b|2] chilladores.

en_us.title: Stone
en_us.subtitle: Quarrying, but seasonal.
text: [lead] [b|8] essences give [b|24] [item:minecraft:cobblestone|Cobblestone].
